title: ArcheAxis Job and Verdict Status Vocabulary
description: Canonical job lifecycle states and research verdicts shared by HTTP, worker NDJSON and MCP surfaces. Closed enums: they gain values only through a new major version (see compatibility-policy.md).

job_status.description: queued/running are non-terminal; succeeded/failed/rejected/cancelled are terminal. 'rejected' means the worker refused the request as invalid (never retryable); 'failed' may be retryable per the error payload.

worker_status.description: Status spoken by worker responses (worker-protocol.schema.json). Core maps succeeded->succeeded, rejected->rejected, failed->failed.

research_verdict.description: Verdict of a bounded cross-check. PARTIAL covers search outage, network loss or budget exhaustion (never a fake PASS). UNMEASURED covers capabilities with no probe. BLOCKED_CREDENTIALS marks product lanes whose external credentials are unconfigured.

machine_competence.description: Competence display for machine lanes: only probed capabilities report MEASURED.
